data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Under pure event sourcing\u2014where all system state is derivable by replaying the append-only log, no external mutable state exists, and every event is deterministic given its predecessors\u2014resumption is safe iff the log is intact and complete up to some committed event N. State is reconstructed by replaying events 1..N, and resumption appends from N+1. Resumption must be refused when the run involved non-deterministic external side effects (tool calls, I/O, randomness) that cannot be replayed, or when external mutable state was modified outside the log.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The run invoked external tool calls or I/O with real-world side effects that are not captured in the event log and cannot be replayed.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The run used randomness without recording the seed or random choices as events, making replay non-deterministic.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"External mutable state was modified during the run but not recorded as events, so state at N is not fully reconstructible from the log alone.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The log appears intact but a concurrent process modified it between halt and resumption, violating single-writer assumptions.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The event-sourcing invariant was violated during the original run (e.g., an in-memory cache was treated as authoritative without being persisted).","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"In pure event sourcing, the log is the single source of truth. A clean halt at event N means the log contains exactly events 1..N with intact identity. Resumption replays to reconstruct state at N, then continues generating N+1 onward. Because state is fully derived from the log and no external mutable state exists, there is no state-log divergence. The append-only identity is preserved because new events extend the existing chain.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
